info.title: HRPF API
info.description: Backend foundations, reviewed public content and atomic publication controls. Operational member/case review workflows remain later milestones. Public reads are no-store and withdrawals take effect immediately. Browser clients use the frontend same-origin /api rewrite and credentials. All mutating auth/admin requests require the exact configured Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Production cookies use Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no Domain; development names omit __Host-.
